description.value: Bar Luna is a Mexican cantina housed in a beautifully restored 1890s fire hall in downtown Nanaimo, offering bold-flavoured tacos, quesabirria, ceviche, and handcrafted mezcal cocktails with a West Coast twist. The heritage building gives the restaurant a distinctive character, though its original front steps make wheelchair access challenging. It can accommodate groups up to 18 in its loft and up to 96 for private events, with catering available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is rich and fully accessible. The FAQ explicitly confirms gluten-free and vegan options, and the navigation includes 'Online Pick Up' confirming takeout. A significant discrepancy exists between OSM phone (+1 250 739-5688) and the website phone ((250) 9869380); the website value is used as more likely current. The OSM address tags have housenumber and street values swapped, but the website confirms the correct address as 7 Victoria Rd, Nanaimo, BC V9R 2S5.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open Mexican restaurant in downtown Nanaimo with an active website, confirmed hours, and takeout service — clearly useful to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Parking is free in the lot in front of the restaurant. Maximum dining group size is 14 in the main room or 18 in the loft; private events up to 96. Gift cards available. Open on holidays per FAQ.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ confirms GF options (all taco shells are 100% organic corn; staff guide guests through GF menu) and vegan options ('we have a couple of options')
